Build the platform every engineering team depends on and shape how Performativ scales through reliability, resilience, and world-class developer experience.

As our Hands-On Lead Cloud Engineer, you will lead Mission Control, our Platform Engineering and Reliability team. Mission Control creates secure, self-service platform capabilities that enable product teams to build, deploy, and operate services independently. This is a hands-on technical leadership role where you'll spend the majority of your time building production infrastructure and platform capabilities, leading through technical contribution rather than process.

What you’ll do 📈

• 
Lead Mission Control while remaining deeply hands-on across cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, and reliability.

• 
Build and evolve the default, secure-by-default platform that enables product teams to build, deploy, and operate services independently.

• 
Create reusable AWS CDK constructs, infrastructure standards, and golden paths that reduce complexity and improve the developer experience across engineering.

• 
Set the technical direction for Mission Control, making pragmatic decisions about platform evolution, reliability, and developer experience while helping the team execute.

• 
Strengthen our reliability practices through SLOs, error budgets, runbooks, incident tooling, and post-incident improvements that drive meaningful change.

• 
Treat cloud cost as a first-class engineering concern by improving visibility, eliminating waste, and designing systems that scale efficiently.

• 
Partner closely with our security specialists to build secure-by-default platform capabilities and continuously strengthen our security posture.

• 
Own the evolution of the engineering platform that enables every product team to build, deploy, and operate services independently.

• 
Provide technical leadership, coaching, and feedback to a small team of experienced platform engineers while remaining deeply involved in delivery.

What we’re looking for 🎯

• 
7+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, or similar production-focused environments.

• 
Experience leading or mentoring engineers while remaining hands-on and actively contributing to code and infrastructure.

• 
Strong experience designing and operating production workloads on AWS, including Infrastructure as Code. Experience with AWS CDK and TypeScript is strongly preferred.

• 
Strong understanding of the AWS Well-Architected Framework and practical application of its principles.

• 
A platform engineering mindset focused on building reusable capabilities, self-service, and engineering leverage.

• 
Strong operational judgment with experience in incident response, reliability engineering, SLOs, and continuous improvement.

• 
Comfort owning outcomes, making decisions in ambiguous environments, and improving engineering practices without adding unnecessary process.

• 
Actively leverages AI and agent-assisted engineering workflows to improve productivity while applying sound engineering judgment and maintaining high quality standards.

• 
Experience working within fintech or other regulated industries is a plus.

Technologies you'll work with 💻

You don't need experience with every technology listed below. We care far more about strong engineering fundamentals, curiosity, and your ability to learn, build, and improve systems.

• 
Infrastructure & Cloud: AWS CDK (TypeScript), Terraform (bonus), and modern AWS infrastructure, networking, security, governance, and observability services.

• 
Engineering Tooling: GitHub Actions, Docker, container pipelines, cloud cost optimization, and observability tooling.

• 
Wider Engineering Stack: You'll collaborate with teams building services primarily in Golang and TypeScript, alongside React, React Native, Python, and PHP.

What we can offer you 🌱

• 
Trust and responsibility to shape the future of Performativ’s success in the European market from day 1.

• 
Join a fast-growing fintech scaleup supported by top-tier VCs.

• 
Work with intelligent, passionate, and driven professionals with experience from leading institutions (such as Goldman Sachs, McKinsey, BCG, Amazon etc).

• 
Accelerate your career with opportunities for professional development and leadership.

Join a Team of Fintech heroes! 🚀

Performativ is making waves in the wealth management ecosystem and is changing the way investment advisors and financial institutions do business around the world. Working at Performativ means working at a fast-paced tech scaleup with intelligent people who are passionate about their work. We are on a scaling journey beyond all metrics and expectations and can't wait to have you join us in making a real impact.

We are funded by some of the leading VC funds in the world and expectations are set to be established as a European market leader in a record amount of time.

You can read more about our product at performativ.com

We value passion 🔥

At Performativ, we are builders first. We are passionate with ambitious goals and value the time and effort people put into their work. You will be part of the family from day one, and responsible for making your mark and driving forward your vision. Autonomous work is embedded in our culture, and we are committed to ensure you have all the tools and support you need while acknowledging the importance of flexibility.

Senior Full-Stack Engineer

• Full-time

• Office: Hellerup

Job Description

We’re looking for a senior full-stack engineer with a strong interest in building AI-first products who enjoys owning problems end-to-end – from vague client needs and early hypotheses to production-grade systems that actually get used.

What you’ll do

You’ll join The Tech Collective (our Data & AI hub, specifically), where we help organisations design, build, and operationalise data- and AI-driven solutions.

This role is tailor-made for a systems thinker and builder – someone who has shipped real products, taken responsibility for technical direction, and is motivated by creating pragmatic solutions that combine data, software, and AI.

You’ll work closely with experienced AI specialists who bring deep model and ML expertise, while you focus on building robust products and software around those capabilities.

Your responsibilities will include:

• End-to-end solution ownership: designing and implementing full-stack applications from early concepts and prototypes to scalable, production-grade systems, including architecture decisions across frontend, backend, data, and cloud

• Modern full-stack development: building high-quality frontend and backend services, applying sound software engineering principles, and using AI-assisted development tools thoughtfully and critically

• AI-enabled product building: collaborating with AI specialists to integrate LLMs, retrieval pipelines, and agentic patterns into real products, and translating AI potential into solutions that make sense for organisations

• Data and systems thinking: designing data models, reasoning about distributed systems and trade-offs, and implementing event-driven or real-time features where they add value

• Observability and evaluation: experience setting up the right observability and eval tooling to establish traceability and iteratively improve on products

• Cloud, delivery, and collaboration: deploying and operating solutions in cloud environments, balancing speed, robustness, and security, and working closely with clients and stakeholders to create tangible business impact

What you’ll bring

We’re looking for someone with an AI builder mentality and 5+ years of hands-on full-stack experience, who is comfortable owning applications end to end – from frontend and backend to data and deployment.

You don’t need to tick every box, but you should recognise yourself in most of the following:

• Strong full-stack foundation: solid skills in TypeScript and/or Python, with experience building and shipping production systems

• Mentoring experience: helping other developers through technical sparring and code reviews

• Outward curiosity: actively seeking to understand client problems in detail and working in close collaboration with them to solve them

• Ownership and leadership: a track record of building substantial solutions from scratch (e.g., startup, scale-up, or personal ventures), taking responsibility for outcomes, and leading technical direction without relying on formal authority

• System-level thinking: the ability to reason about architecture, data flows, trade-offs, and failure modes across the stack, and to make pragmatic decisions in ambiguous contexts

• Critical technical judgement: a keen eye for identifying weaknesses in existing architectures and tech stacks, and knowing where and how to improve them

• Communication and collaboration: the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders, work across disciplines, and learn from – and share knowledge with – others in the team and across Implement

• Tool agnostic: capable of choosing the right tool for the job

What we offer

We offer a role with technical ownership and influence, working in a 20-person team that feels much closer to a nerdy startup than a large corporation – while being firmly backed by Implement Consulting Group.

You’ll gain exposure to a wide range of data- and AI-driven problems across industries, all within a culture built on trust, curiosity, humility, resilience, and impact. You’ll also have great freedom to shape your own role, deepen your expertise, and grow in exactly the direction that motivates you.

Ready to shape the digital future with us? Apply ASAP.

About The Tech Collective

The Tech Collective is a fast-growing consulting company powered by Implement Consulting Group. We aim to make a positive difference in the consulting industry, believing that the ability to create change with impact and purpose is a prerequisite for success in a global and turbulent world.

We’re expanding our team and look forward to meeting talented people who are curious about a career in information systems and management consulting at the intersection of business and technology.

Senior Purview Specialist

• Full-time

• Office: Hellerup

Job Description

We're looking for an experienced Microsoft Purview specialist with a proven track record of delivering compliance projects for clients who’s ready to own and develop our Purview capability as the agentic landscape evolves.

What you'll do

You'll work on Microsoft Purview and compliance implementations end-to-end – from architecture and deployment to use case optimisation – with a particular focus on agentic adoption.

You'll be the person who drives the Purview agenda on behalf of an ambitious team, working across industries with organisations that are serious about data security and compliance.

In this role, you'll own:

• 
Design, deployment, and optimisation of Microsoft Purview solutions, including Data Classification, Information Protection, Data Loss Prevention, and Insider Risk Management

• 
Development of data protection policies, automation workflows, and compliance reporting tailored to client requirements

• 
Assessment and reporting on the maturity of client data security and compliance deployments

• 
Definition and creation of operational and executive compliance dashboards and reports

• 
Integration activities across Microsoft Purview and the broader Microsoft 365 compliance ecosystem

You'll also collaborate closely with other engineers on the team, contribute to R&D activities, and support managed service customers in maintaining and maturing their data security practices.

What you'll bring

We're looking for someone with at least three years of hands-on experience enabling security and compliance technologies in a Microsoft environment. Beyond that, you'll bring:

• 
Strong experience with Microsoft Purview across Data Classification, Information Protection, DLP, and Insider Risk Management

• 
Hands-on experience implementing sensitivity labels, retention policies, and DLP rules

• 
Knowledge of data governance principles within the Microsoft ecosystem

• 
Current Microsoft certifications in compliance and security – or a willingness to obtain them within 90 days

• 
Strong communication skills and confidence in client-facing settings

We don't expect you to know everything. Purview and the agentic space are moving fast, and that's part of what makes this role interesting. What matters most is that you want to own it.

To be a great fit for The Tech Collective, it will be a bonus if you bring:

• 
Knowledge of LLMs and agentic workflows, including cybersecurity risk considerations

• 
Understanding of Zero Trust principles as applied to data security

• 
Experience with risk assessment methodologies and compliance reporting

• 
Microsoft Certified: Information Protection Administrator Associate, Security Administrator Associate, or equivalent

What we offer

On top of a competitive salary and bonus package, you'll join a tight team of experts and enthusiasts who take both craft and collaboration seriously. We invest in your development – through training, conferences, and the space to pursue research in areas you're passionate about.

We combine remote work with meaningful co-working at our offices in Copenhagen and will provide you with the tooling and hardware required to reach our goal of building a unique red team platform.

For questions, contact Anders Rømer Skøtt at anrs@thetechcollective.eu or +45 31717487.

Senior IT Supporter

_

As a Senior Front-End Engineer, you will co-own the front-end experience for Performativ's trading and analytics platform, building high-performance interfaces used by wealth managers and financial institutions. This is a hands-on engineering role with direct ownership of architecture, implementation, and production outcomes.

About the team 👥

The engineering team owns the platform that powers portfolio management, trading, analytics, reporting, compliance, and client engagement at Performativ. Front-end engineers work closely with backend engineers, product, and design to turn complex financial workflows into software that advisors can use every day.

The team ships continuously and gives engineers ownership over implementation decisions. On the front end, the current focus is scaling a Next.js and React architecture across increasingly sophisticated workflows while keeping performance, server and client boundaries, theming, and shared components under control.

About the role 🎯

We are looking for a Senior Front-End Engineer to co-own the quality, performance, and architecture of our trading and analytics interfaces. This role is responsible for building production UIs, shaping front-end architecture, and raising the standard of our shared component infrastructure.

You will work closely with backend engineering, product, and design to ship financial workflows from requirements through production. You will co-own the end-to-end front-end scope, including server and client boundaries, hydration strategy, state management, performance, multi-tenant theming, testing, and the component library used across the platform.

This role requires deep React and TypeScript expertise, strong architectural judgment, and the ability to turn complex financial workflows into fast, usable interfaces. You need to be comfortable making implementation decisions independently and shipping production software without management overhead.

This role is based in Copenhagen. We work together from our city-center office, with working from home possible when there is a good reason. You should already be based in Copenhagen or be ready to relocate.

What you'll do 📈

• 
Build high-performance trading, analytics, and portfolio management interfaces used by wealth management professionals.

• 
Co-own front-end architecture across Next.js 15, React Server Components, TypeScript, and our shared application infrastructure.

• 
Define server and client boundaries, hydration strategies, and state patterns that keep the platform responsive as complexity grows.

• 
Scale our shared component library and multi-tenant theming across the platform.

• 
Improve runtime performance, bundle size, rendering behavior, and application responsiveness.

• 
Ship production features quickly while making architectural decisions that hold up as the product scales.

• 
Use AI coding agents where they improve engineering throughput while maintaining control over code quality and implementation decisions.

• 
Strengthen front-end testing and delivery across Vitest or Jest, Testing Library, Playwright, and CI/CD workflows.

• 
Co-own implementation decisions from product outcome through production deployment.

What we're looking for 🔍

• 
Have built sophisticated production web applications with React and TypeScript and can structure front-end codebases that continue to work as product complexity grows.

• 
Understand modern React architecture, including React Server Components and the Next.js App Router, or can demonstrate the technical depth to become productive with them quickly.

• 
Have shipped production work using AI coding agents and understand where they improve engineering output and where direct engineering judgment is required.

• 
Have improved front-end performance through decisions around bundle size, hydration, rendering, data fetching, and runtime behavior.

• 
Are comfortable managing server state with TanStack Query and can make deliberate decisions about colocated state and client state libraries.

• 
Have built or extended component systems using tools such as Radix, shadcn/ui, or custom design systems.

• 
Understand usability, accessibility, and interaction design well enough to make sound UX decisions without treating design as somebody else's problem.

• 
Have shipped tested production software using tools such as Vitest or Jest, Testing Library, Playwright, and automated CI/CD pipelines.

Preferred experience ➕

• 
Have worked on trading, investment management, portfolio analytics, or other data-intensive financial applications.

• 
Have worked with AG Grid or comparable data-grid infrastructure for complex datasets and interactions.

• 
Have worked in a pnpm and Turborepo monorepo with generated API types from OpenAPI specifications.

• 
Have designed front-end systems supporting multiple tenants, brands, or configurable themes.

• 
Have mentored engineers or raised engineering standards without moving away from hands-on development.

What we can offer you 🌱

• 
Work that reaches production fast. We ship weekly. Your work will be used by advisors and financial institutions within days, not quarters.

• 
Colleagues who set a high bar. Our team comes from Goldman Sachs, McKinsey, BCG, and Amazon. Standards are high. Politics are absent.

• 
Career compression. People here take on scope in twelve months that takes five years elsewhere. If you can carry it, we will give it to you.

• 
Direct access to founders, customers, and the market. You will sit in the rooms where decisions get made.

• 
Backing from leading venture funds, and a mandate to become the European standard rather than a regional alternative.

About Performativ 🚀

Wealth management runs on software built for a different era. Batch files. Overnight reconciliation. Client reports assembled by hand. Advisors spend more time fighting their systems than advising clients. The industry has accepted this for thirty years.

We are replacing that layer. Performativ is one platform for portfolio management, reporting, compliance, and client engagement, built from the ground up for how wealth is actually managed today. Banks, family offices, and independent advisors across Europe run on it.

We are a scaleup, not a startup. The product is live, the customers are real, and the growth is ahead of plan. We intend to be the system European wealth management runs on. That is not positioning. It is the plan we are executing against.

You can read more about our product at performativ.com

The bar 🔥

We are builders. We move fast, we say what we think, and we do not manage each other. Autonomy is the default, which only works if you are the kind of person who does not need to be told twice.

This is not a role for someone looking to coast inside a growing company. It is a role for someone who wants scope, wants pressure, and wants to point at something in two years and say they built it. If that is you, apply. If it is not, this will be uncomfortable, and we would rather say so now.

Process Consultant – Help Shape Energinet’s Process Work

Do you want to be part of a workplace that is continuously evolving in step with the accelerating green transition?

Then join a team with the central task of developing and documenting our OT processes.

Welcome to Energinet

In our Process Team, we are seven colleagues working closely together to document and develop business processes and workflows across Energinet.

We strive for standardized processes, which help ensure transparency, alignment, and cross-organizational overview. Furthermore, we have a strategic partnership with the Process Center of Excellence – a cross-functional office responsible for raising process maturity across all of Energinet.

You Document and Develop Processes

We work in an agile setup, where the Scrum Master facilitates the team’s events. Each day begins with a short team meeting to align on tasks and priorities. We value starting the day together before diving into individual or collaborative work.

Our main task in 2025 is to ensure that our OT processes cover our new platform, enabling us to manage operations and preparedness effectively. The work is wide-ranging and involves many capabilities and tools. We are in constant dialogue with our technical teams and security department. This requires you to collaborate with stakeholders and process owners, and to document processes according to the BPMN notation.

• Your key responsibilities will include:

• Documenting as-is processes

• Designing, developing, and maturing IT and OT processes

• Conducting stakeholder interviews

• Facilitating workshops

• Performing quality assurance

• Providing ad hoc support for process documentation and development

You Have Strong Experience in Process Management

We are looking for someone with excellent communication and analytical skills, who can translate expert knowledge into clearly documented processes aligned with Energinet’s standards. You enjoy both administrative and formalization tasks and thrive in a collaborative environment where you provide service and support across teams.

• We imagine that you:

• Have solid experience with ITIL 4

• Have experience in process mapping, preferably with BPMN

• Thrive in an agile (Scrum) environment

• Preferably have experience with ServiceNow

• Have knowledge of CMMI process maturity

• Understand the connection between main and sub-process levels, and perhaps have insight into digital processes in an IT/OT organization

• Speak and write English fluently (Danish is an advantage but not a requirement)

Special Conditions

The position requires that you can obtain and maintain a security clearance.

You can read more about this process on the PET website.

In certain cases, a background check may be required before clearance is granted.

Location and Work Setup

We are based in Fredericia and offer a flexible hybrid model for on-site and remote work.

jobs.occupation: Senior Finance Business Partner with focus on Mobility
jobs.description:
Picture yourself serving as a trusted advisor to the Danish management team in a global company, where your contribution can truly make a difference. Then imagine holding this meaningful position while working on what you do best – analysis, forecasting, and numbers.

Basico is recruiting a Senior Finance Business Partner on behalf of Circle K.

Allow us to bring the vision to life! At Circle K they are looking for you, with experience from similar roles - ready to step into this position and become part of our ambitious and highly skilled team in the Performance Management Analytics (PMA) department, based out of the Danish headquarter in Copenhagen, Sydhavn, Denmark.

It’s a numbers game – and you’ve mastered it

Circle K is one of the leading companies in Denmark in the convenience, energy, and fuel delivery sector. In Denmark, Circle K operates two different brands – Circle K and INGO – spread across 436 locations, with 211 of those operated under the Circle K brand.

As a part of Circle K’s PMA team, you will have 3 skilled colleagues you can consult with on financial matters. However, as you will be working with many different stakeholders, you will quickly learn that cooperation and collaboration across the organization is key – especially for this role.

As Senior Finance Business Partner, you will be the responsible sparring partner to both their Mobility and Sales department, translating numbers into actionable insights, building business cases, and much more. This involves sparring and partnering with the organization on matters such as fuel, E-Mobility, Car wash, B2B Customers, and more.

To be specific, your main responsibilities will be to:

· Partner with the Mobility and Sales department to create transparency in financial figures and drive qualified decision-making through fact-based recommendations.

· Work closely with the business to identify challenges and optimization opportunities.

· Analyze business performance and bring financial insights and recommendations to management.

· Improve and execute budgeting and forecasting processes within your area of responsibility, ensuring accuracy, transparency, and alignment with other areas.

· Analyze and explain developments in month-end figures.

· Build and review business cases.

· Communicate and present business cases and ad hoc analysis to management and other stakeholders.

Your business acumen makes you the preferred advisor

To be successful in this role, we imagine you have at least a few years' experience from a similar role. Since you are used to managing the interests of many different stakeholders, you have already tested your ability to work in a structured and proactive manner in an ever-changing environment, where balancing tasks is key to success.

You might hold a degree in Economics and Business administration, Accounting or Finance. Most important is however your authentic curiosity to understand causal relationships, developments, trends, and the willingness to dive into an Excel sheet full of numbers to grasp what is happening.

If you are an ambitious profile with solid understanding of finance processes, has an analytical mindset, and are motivated to make a difference, you will be a great match for the PMA team.

As sparring partner to the business, it is also important that you are able to simplify complex issues and present them with confidence to all levels in the organization in an inspiring way that makes people listen.

As you become part of an international organization where you advise colleagues from different countries, it is necessary that you are fluent in both English and Danish.

On the right path – Come join Circle K!

You will become part of an international organization in rapid development, working with many exciting initiatives redefining the future of Circle K’s business. Furthermore, when they say that diversity and sustainability are on the agenda, they mean it, and they care—also about future generations. Circle K have several initiatives they would love to tell you more about when you meet.

Circle K’s four core values—One Team, Do The Right Thing, Take Ownership, Play To Win—reflect the culture you will become a part of. When joining the PMA team, you will learn that humor, professionalism and a willingness to take responsibility are significant parts of the company’s DNA. If you have the same DNA, we will look forward to hearing from you.

Do you have all the facts you need to make your next move? Then send us your CV and application via the link below. We process applications confidentially and invite candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis.

If you have any questions about the position, please feel free to contact Gitte Hjortskov Larsen, Director of Executive Search & Recruitment at Basico, by phone at +45 2510 2217.

At Circle K, there is room for everyone, and they always work together as One Team! Circle K value diversity and different ways of thinking and working. Therefore, they encourage everyone to apply for the position—regardless of age, gender, religion, disability, ethnic background, etc. What matters most to Circle K is who you are as a person, and what you bring to the team. We therefore encourage you not to include a photo on your CV.

Ready to build the AI engine behind the world's largest jewellery brand?

As Lead AI Platform Engineer, you will be the technical force behind Pandora's AI platform, shaping how AI systems are built, scaled, and secured across the business. Combining deep hands-on engineering expertise with strong technical leadership, you will drive architectural excellence, elevate engineering standards, and deliver reliable, production-ready AI solutions at scale.

Your Key Responsibilities Will Be To:

Technical Leadership

• Serve as the technical lead for the AI platform engineering team — setting the implementation direction, defining coding standards, and making key technical decisions that govern how the platform is built and evolved.

• Lead code reviews and drive architecture discussions, ensuring engineering decisions are well-reasoned, documented, and aligned with the broader platform strategy — championing engineering standards across code quality, testing practices, documentation, observability, and security hardening.

• Act as a technical mentor and go-to resource for all engineers — sharing knowledge, unblocking complex problems, and actively investing in the technical growth of both senior and junior team members.

Platform Engineering & AI Infrastructure

• Design, build, and operate scalable, high-performance services and platform components that expose AI/ML capabilities across Pandora's digital ecosystem.

• Own and define the standards and governance for Terraform-based Infrastructure as Code (IaC) — ensuring all Azure infrastructure is reproducible, auditable, and securely configured.

• Apply strong network architecture knowledge to design and govern secure connectivity between platform services, AI gateways, and external integrations, including VNet, private endpoints, NSGs, and ingress/egress controls, while collaborating with security stakeholders to uphold the platform's overall security posture.

• Leverage Databricks for big data processing, feature engineering, and ML pipeline support.

AI Services & Agentic Development

• Integrate and operationalise AI services including LLM APIs, vector search, RAG pipelines, embeddings, and multi-layer caching into platform-level services.

• Lead the agentic code development practice: architecting autonomous execution loops that enable tools like Claude Code and GitHub Copilot to safely write, test, and self-correct software within isolated sandboxes.

• Own MLflow governance standards for experiment tracking, model versioning, and ML lifecycle management across the team.

• Configure and manage AI gateways to ensure secure, scalable, and governed access to AI capabilities at production scale.

CI/CD & Reliability

• Define and govern the CI/CD standards for the AI platform team — establishing quality gates, testing frameworks, deployment patterns, and pipeline architecture that all engineers build to.

• Ensure performance, availability, and maintainability of platform services in production; handle incidents in a timely manner to minimise Mean Time to Contain (MTTC).

Job Requirements:

Education & Experience

• Relevant background from Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field with experience in backend or platform engineering, with at least 2 years operating in a technical leadership capacity within AI or cloud-native platform teams.

• Proven experience building and operating AI/ML platform services or LLM-based integrations in a production environment.

Technical Skills

• Strong backend engineering fundamentals: service architecture, REST API design, performance optimisation, and production reliability by design and monitoring, with hands-on proficiency in Python.

• Deep Kubernetes expertise — workload configuration, networking, security policy design, and production debugging; hands-on Docker and Azure App Services.

• Expert-level Terraform and IaC ownership — defining standards, patterns, and governance for cloud infrastructure on Azure.

• Strong network architecture and configuration skills, including Azure networking concepts (VNet, NSG, private endpoints, DNS, ingress/egress).

• MLflow governance, Databricks for ML pipeline integration, and experience with ML serving infrastructure, LLM APIs, prompt integration, and multi-layer caching.

• Proficiency in PostgreSQL and experience in configuring AI gateways for centralized AI governance

• Experience in agentic code development practice, harness engineering and spec-driven development is a plus.

Soft Skills

Ideally you are a trusted technical leader who combines strong engineering expertise with clear thinking and a collaborative approach to drive sound decisions, communicate complex platform, security, and architecture topics in a business-friendly way, and foster team growth. Brings a proactive and curious mindset, with a passion for emerging AI technologies balanced by a pragmatic focus on execution and delivery.

About the Team

You will be part of Pandora's AI Platform team within AI CoE at Digital & Analytics & AI — a passionate, forward-thinking group dedicated to building the infrastructure and services that bring AI to life across the business. The team works at the intersection of data science, machine learning, cloud engineering, and product development, collaborating closely with ML Engineers, Data Scientists, AI Architects, and Product stakeholders.

You will report to the AI Platform Manager and serve as the senior technical voice that shapes how the platform is designed, secured, and evolved — influencing both what gets built and how it gets built.

Did we get your attention?

We hope you got all your questions answered and feel confident applying for this position. If you see yourself in the role and would like to become a part of Pandora’s future, please do not hesitate to apply! We are an international team, so please make sure to send us your application in English to be considered. We look forward to hearing from you!

We process applications on a continuous basis, which is why we encourage you to send your application as soon as possible. You can also read more about Pandora on our corporate site www.pandoragroup.com.

Icing on the cake
